title: Getting Dressed
context: Choosing clothes, putting them on, taking them off — simple actions with very specific English verbs that don't translate word-for-word from Persian.
contextPersian: انتخاب لباس، پوشیدن و درآوردن — کارهای ساده‌ای که فعل‌های انگلیسی مخصوص خودشان را دارند و ترجمه کلمه‌به‌کلمه از فارسی جواب نمی‌دهد.

expressions.example: Give me ten minutes to get dressed.
expressions.examplePersian: ده دقیقه بهم وقت بده لباس بپوشم.
expressions.note: General act of dressing. For one item, use 'put on'.

expressions.example: Put on a warm jacket — it's freezing outside.
expressions.examplePersian: یک کاپشن گرم بپوش — بیرون خیلی سرد است.

expressions.example: You can take off your shoes here.
Can I try on this shirt in a medium?
expressions.examplePersian: می‌توانم این پیراهن را سایز مدیوم پرو کنم؟

expressions.example: These jeans don't fit anymore — they're too tight.
expressions.examplePersian: این شلوار جین دیگر اندازه نیست — خیلی تنگ شده.
expressions.note: Fit = size. Suit = looks good on you: 'That color suits you.'

expressions.example: I'll get changed after work and meet you there.
expressions.examplePersian: بعد از کار لباس عوض می‌کنم و همان‌جا می‌بینمت.

expressions.example: Hold on, let me do up my buttons.
Does this shirt match these trousers?
expressions.examplePersian: این پیراهن با این شلوار هم‌خوانی دارد؟

exercises.prompt: In a clothes shop, you want to test a jacket before buying. You ask: Can I ___ it ___?
The shirt is the wrong size. You say:
exercises.explanation: Wrong size → doesn't fit. Wrong look → doesn't suit you.
exercises.explanationPersian: اندازه نبودن: doesn't fit؛ نیامدن به کسی: doesn't suit.

exercises.after: on a warm jacket. (put / take / try)

speakingTask.instruction: Describe what you're wearing today and what you put on this morning.
speakingTask.instructionPersian: بگو امروز چه پوشیده‌ای و صبح چه لباسی تنت کردی.
modelSentences: This morning I got dressed in about five minutes.
I put on a white shirt and dark trousers.
I tried on two jackets before choosing this one.
When I get home, I'll get changed into something comfortable.

roleplay.aiRole: A shop assistant in a clothes store
roleplay.learnerRole: A customer looking for a shirt for work
roleplay.objective: Ask to try things on, talk about size, fit and color
roleplay.context: The learner wants a work shirt. The first one doesn't fit; discuss sizes and whether colors suit them, then decide.
roleplay.opening: Hi there! Looking for anything in particular today?
